definitions.explanation: A tool used to remove bottle caps, especially from glass bottles with pry-off caps.

examples.japanese: {栓|せん}{抜|ぬ}きでビール{瓶|びん}を{開|あ}けた。
examples.english: I opened the beer bottle with a bottle opener.

examples.japanese: {栓|せん}{抜|ぬ}きがなくて、{歯|は}で{開|あ}けようとした。
examples.english: I didn't have a bottle opener, so I tried to open it with my teeth.

examples.japanese: この{栓|せん}{抜|ぬ}きは{缶切|かんき}りも{付|つ}いている。
examples.english: This bottle opener also has a can opener attached.

notes:
FORMATION:
{栓|せん} (stopper/cork) + {抜|ぬ}き (from {抜|ぬ}く, to pull out)

Literally 'stopper-puller.'

COLLOCATIONS:
・{栓|せん}{抜|ぬ}きで{開|あ}ける - to open with a bottle opener
・{王冠|おうかん}を{抜|ぬ}く - to remove a bottle cap

RELATED TOOLS:
・{缶切|かんき}り - can opener
・コルク{抜|ぬ}き - corkscrew
・{爪切|つめき}り - nail clippers
